tagline: Gentle stories for sweet little dreams.
style: Soft children's picture-book illustration featuring gentle pastel colors, rounded shapes, clean outlines, warm sunlit glow, and whimsical cozy details.
world: A cozy, sun-dappled woodland village named Whispering Hollow, filled with miniature hollow-tree houses, soft mossy paths, and glowing flower gardens.

characters.name: Pip
characters.look: A tiny chestnut-brown mouse wearing oversized mint-green overalls, big round glossy black eyes, a pink button nose, and soft velvety ears.
characters.personality: Curious, gentle, and always eager to learn something new each day.

characters.name: Barnaby
characters.look: A chubby cream-colored bear cub wearing a cozy mustard-yellow knitted scarf, soft black eyes, a warm smile, and fuzzy round ears.
characters.personality: Kind-hearted, patient, quiet, and loves sharing delicious homemade berry snacks.

characters.name: Flora
characters.look: A small round hedgehog with soft cream spines, wearing a little lavender apron with a pocket, bright eyes, and tiny wooden glasses.
characters.personality: Wise, nurturing, soft-spoken, and wonderful at giving gentle comforting advice.
